title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - GPU
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/GPU. Graphical processing unit of virtual and physical machines. Subclass of Device per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the Device model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'GPU'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

gpuMemory.description: Relationship. Size of memory of the GPU. Links to a MemorySize entity.

gpuInterconnection.description: Property. Interconnection of multiple GPUs within a server system. Controlled-vocabulary value (GPUInterconnetionTypes), enumeration not resolved in this pass.

gpuProcessingUnits.description: Property. Number of processing units (compute/execution units or streaming multiprocessors) of the GPU.

gpuPassthrough.description: Property. Indicates whether the GPU is provided via passthrough (true) or virtualized (false).
